ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   C. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   C. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   C. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   D. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   D. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and Umrah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Commanding good and forbidding evil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
